summary.text: Ashley Hammac is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Kendell Culp. A consultant who describes himself as a soil scientist, he holds a Ph.D. from Washington State University.

paragraphs.text: Hammac earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arkansas in 2002, a graduate degree from Auburn University in 2005, and a Ph.D. from Washington State University in 2015.
His career experience includes working as a consultant.
Hammac advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a soil scientist and a father, and that he wants to return decision-making power to local communities.
He said his central goal is to promote a local, sustainable, agriculture-based supply chain for rural Indiana.
